edits.text: PARTIES; DATES. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. (the “Company”) and [Executive’s full legal name] (the “Executive”), effective [date], with employment commencing [date]. This draft is subject to client approval and execution by both parties.

1. POSITION; EMPLOYMENT STATUS. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer, reporting to [title], with duties [to be agreed] and a principal work location of [location]. Employment is at will: either party may terminate employment at any time, with or without Cause or advance notice, subject to applicable law and the Company’s payment obligations under this Agreement.

2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of USD 250,000, payable through the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to required withholding. The Executive shall be eligible for standard employee benefits subject to the applicable plans and their eligibility requirements. Any bonus shall be discretionary. No equity award is guaranteed under this Agreement.

3. TERMINATION; SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, the Company shall pay severance equal to three months of the Executive’s then-current base salary, in payroll installments over three months, subject to required withholding, execution and non-revocation of a release, and continuing compliance with lawful surviving obligations under this Agreement. Release delivery, execution and payment commencement mechanics remain to be agreed, subject to applicable law. Accrued compensation and any other amounts required by law shall be paid separately within the legally required time periods and shall not be conditioned on a release. “Cause” means fraud, material misconduct, or material breach of this Agreement, subject to written notice describing the grounds and a reasonable opportunity to cure where curable.

4. PROPOSED POST-EMPLOYMENT RESTRICTION—OPEN; NOT AGREED. The parties reserve for further discussion a proposed twelve-month restriction limited to directly competitive duties involving business lines for which the Executive had material responsibility and territories actually served, only to the extent enforceable under applicable law. No operative non-compete covenant is established by this paragraph. Duration, scope, protected business interest and enforceability remain subject to review after the work location and governing law are identified.

receiver.message_back: Subject to client approval and execution, we propose that the release be delivered within five days after termination, allow the applicable statutory consideration and revocation periods, and provide for severance installments to begin on the first payroll after effectiveness, with any catch-up payment then due; continuing-compliance conditions must be expressly identified and limited to lawful surviving obligations, without affecting accrued statutory payments. Executive identity, dates, duties, reporting line, location and governing law remain subject to client confirmation; any proposed twelve-month restriction would protect confidential information and customer goodwill and cover only directly competitive duties in business lines materially overseen and territories actually served by the Executive during the final twelve months, with the specific activities and territories to be scheduled and enforceability reviewed before agreement.
